sentences.en: But we can also activate the cytoplast at the same time as the donor nucleus is introduced.

sentences.en: One group of ewes simply provides oocytes, which, when enucleated, become the receiving cytoplasts.

sentences.en: Thus they achieved nuclear transfer without ever penetrating karyoplast or cytoplast at all.

sentences.en: What would happen if they transferred nuclei from two-cell embryos into enucleated cytoplasts taken from two-cell embryos?

sentences.en: The paper mainly reviewed several factors on influencing somatic cloning of pigs , which involve in cytoplast recipients, donor cells, micromanipulation, activation and reconstituted embryo transfer .
